codeType: Refactoring (classic-script module split, build wiring, loader tests)

techniques.name: Breaking Changes
findings: All consumers of the removed monolith paths were enumerated by the analyze trio and updated: build.mjs INGAME_FILES, test/estate-neighbor-allocation.mjs, test/heatmap-projection-allocation.mjs, test/performance-regressions.mjs, test/benchmark-runtime-performance.mjs (with pre-split baseline fallback), test/fixtures/game-constants.json (4 record swaps regenerated).
Runtime consumers (bootstrap.js, quick-panel.js) bind by symbol name in shared scope, not by file path; unaffected.
AUTO_BOT_FILES filter cannot match the new estate/* or heatmaps/* paths; autobot artifact unaffected.

techniques.name: Regression Analysis
findings: Both monoliths split as pure byte-identical moves: empty diffs; concat sha256 1b4c2058... (estate) and 13e767bb... (heatmaps) equal the frozen candidate hashes recorded in the 2026-10-14 performance receipts, proving the uncommitted perf patches moved verbatim.
Benchmark exact-output assertions pass on all four fixtures; allocation counters preserved (1 scratch buffer, 1 distinct world input).
All ten integration validation commands exit 0 (build, smoke, ingame-section-bootstrap, build-parity, both allocation tests, performance-regressions, check:constants, benchmark, scoped eslint).

techniques.name: Backward Compatibility
findings: Bundle section order preserved: estate block replaces the estate entry at its original INGAME_FILES slot (between boat-panel.js and auto-leave.js); heatmaps block replaces heatmaps.js at its slot (between boat-macro.js and spawn-index.js).
Receipt schema of the benchmark unchanged; candidate counters unchanged; no behavior or gameplay change introduced (pure move + wiring).
Committed artifacts regenerated by npm run build and verified by check:build-parity against a fresh temp-dir build.

notes: Estate-only eslint override (prefer-const, sonarjs/no-implicit-global) added with shared-scope rationale; heatmaps needed none. Fixture diff proven against pre-write backup: exactly 4 record swaps; pre-existing foreign fixture lines untouched.
